title: "V0012 keyword_expression_operand"

An error from the `parse` phase. `sakura explain V0012` prints this explanation offline.

`if`, `match`, `with`, `try`, `fn`, `handler` and `fail` expressions cannot be operands of a
binary or postfix operator without parentheses (design §3.2).

Wrong:

```sakura
match x { … }.len()
```

Fixed:

```sakura
(match x { … }).len()
```

[`compiler/tests/ui/V0012_keyword_expression_operand.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V0012_keyword_expression_operand.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:
